Introduction

Platform Overview

CVify is an AI Job Application System designed to turn your career history into a high-converting job application bundle. The platform solves the "Black Box" problem of ATS by giving users a real-time, AI-backed auditor that mimics modern hiring pipelines.

Job Application System

Not just a resume builder. It's an end-to-end engine that analyzes, rewrites, and prepares your entire kit for specific job roles.

AI Trust & Control

AI suggests improvements based on actual 24-point ATS benchmarks. You stay in control — approve or edit every change.

Instant Results

No signup required to start. Get your ATS score in 30 seconds and see exactly why you're being filtered out.

The Application Kit

One profile generates multiple job-specific versions. Get a tailored Resume + Cover Letter + Live Profile in one click.
